Name: MRC - Desert Trader has unlimited Magic Rock Candy stock
Author: CasualFBIAgent
Description:
This mod reverts the 1.4.1 nerf to the Desert Trader's Magic Rock Candy stock, allowing you to spend as many Prismatic Shards as you like all at once. No more having to wait an entire week just to spend 3 Shards out of your likely bloated supply. His rotating stock is unaffected--the only thing this mod does is make his Thursday MRC supply unlimited. Simply extract the files and drop them in your mods folder. Requires CP and SMAPI.

I'm a newbie to modding so please tell me if you notice any quirks, though I can't imagine you'd find any. I made this because I couldn't find a standalone mod that had the same function and figured it could be useful to other people as well.
